velocity.loc_breakdown_note: NET LOC deletion across motoko_agent. Gross LOC churn is much higher (~1700 added across milestones, ~2700 deleted in M7+M10). Velocity is intentionally lower than AILANG-internal sprints because this is cross-repo with arni-decision gates and a 5-provider test matrix.

features.description: Integrate dispatch_response_intercept(ext, response_text) into v2's per-turn flow. Each step() return calls intercept, branches on Accept / ContinueWithFeedback / NoIntercept / NoDecision. ~150 LOC added to agent_loop_v2.ail; rpc_loop unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: v2 calls dispatch_response_intercept(ext, result.message.content) on each step return
Accept(output) short-circuits the loop with done event carrying output
ContinueWithFeedback(fb) injects {role:user, content:fb} message and recurses
NoIntercept and NoDecision fall through to tool dispatch unchanged
Smoke test scripts/smoke_v2_intercept.ail with synthetic Accept stub passes
make check_core still passes (currently 22/22)

features.description: Run apply_tool_policy on the typed [ToolCall] from step. Translate ToolCall ↔ ToolCallEnvelope (M1 adapter), pass to existing gating logic, get back gated.allowed and gated.denied. Denied calls become tool-result messages with denial reason. ~120 LOC.
acceptance_criteria: v2 calls policy gate on every typed [ToolCall] returned by step()
gated.allowed flows to native dispatch; gated.denied becomes tool-role messages with denial JSON
Denied calls do NOT reach run_native_batch
Smoke test: synthetic stub denies BashExec; v2 emits denied tool-result message
All M3 acceptance criteria still hold (regression-free)

features.description: Integrate route_tool_handles_typed to let extensions handle specific tool names directly. Migrate compose extensions (claimcheck, author_loop) per arni's chosen path (a/b/c). ~300 LOC — heaviest individual milestone.
acceptance_criteria: Extension-routed tools (e.g. compose_check_premise) bypass run_native_batch and return their own ToolResultEnvelope
claimcheck still validates compose-author output between turns per arni's chosen migration path
author_loop still injects multi-attempt feedback for ailang-snippet authoring
One existing claimcheck-using benchmark task passes end-to-end
All M3+M4 acceptance criteria still hold
features.notes: GATING: arni must choose option (a) typed migration / (b) compatibility shim / (c) drop compose extensions before this milestone starts.

features.description: Integrate split_by_backend(handled.passthrough, settings.ohmy_pi). Native calls go through run_native_batch; delegated calls go through ohmy_pi's existing infrastructure. ~230 LOC.
acceptance_criteria: Native tool calls dispatch through run_native_batch exactly as today
Delegated tool calls dispatch through ohmy_pi's existing client and return ToolResultEnvelopes
Mixed batches (some native, some delegated) work correctly
settings.ohmy_pi=false falls back to all-native dispatch with no errors
Smoke test against ohmy_pi-configured backend passes
All M3-M5 acceptance criteria still hold
features.notes: GATING: arni must answer four ohmy_pi questions before this milestone starts. Fallback option (b) defer ohmy_pi if blocking — return ToolErrorResult for delegated calls.

features.description: Hybrid mode: extract_bash shorthand for prose containing $ <cmd> when no typed tool_calls. DELETE parse_tool_calls, indicates_continuation_intent, extract_any_tool_json_candidate, looks_like_non_json_tool_syntax, parse_legacy_terminal_call, parse_legacy_direct_call from parse.ail. ~100 LOC added + ~400 LOC deleted = ~300 LOC NET DELETION.
acceptance_criteria: v2 falls through to extract_bash when step() returns tool_calls=[] AND finish_reason=stop AND prose contains $ <cmd> line-prefix
Extracted bash command becomes a synthetic BashExec tool call dispatched through native path
Smoke test: MOTOKO_AGENT_V2=1 motoko "$ pwd" works
make check_core still passes
~400 LOC deleted from parse.ail with no regression

features.description: Multi-turn conversation loop: after v2's main task completes (done event), loop back for the user's next task input. ~80 LOC.
acceptance_criteria: After v2 emits done, awaits next user input via stdin/env-server
New user message gets appended to running message history
Loop resumes via fresh step() call with appended history
TUI session smoke test: two consecutive prompts work without restart
TUI state machine handles v2 done→next-task transition correctly

features.description: Validate v2 across 5 model providers × 5 benchmark tasks. Capture model-specific quirks (Gemini functionCall ID generation, OpenAI argument-string-vs-object). ~150 LOC driver + ~200 LOC benchmark fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Claude Sonnet 4.5: 5/5 benchmark tasks pass
Gemini 3 Pro: 5/5 pass (likely surfaces functionCall ID quirks — fix upstream)
GPT-5: 5/5 pass
GLM-5: at least 4/5 pass (acceptable for smaller OS model)
MiniMax M2.7: at least 4/5 pass
Any per-provider bug found gets a regression test in upstream internal/ai/<provider>/step_test.go
Documented compatibility matrix in docs/v2-model-compatibility.md
